scope: Native Windows WebView fullscreen permission fixture focus ordering; no production permission or fullscreen policy change

reproduced.result: 2 passed, 1 failed; actual native/document focus precondition failed before requesting fullscreen

cause: The fixture first focused BrowserWidget (whose focusInEvent moves focus into WebView), then called Win32 SetFocus on the parent HWND. Qt could still consider the widget focused, suppressing a new focusInEvent and leaving document.hasFocus false.
correction: Activate the real foreground window first, then explicitly transfer Qt focus through BrowserWidget into its WebView. Never overwrite that focus with SetFocus(parent HWND).
unchangedGates: The actual native foreground HWND must belong to the fixture
Block, Ask/Deny, Allow and exit still assert real fullscreen signals and page state
limits: This is a Windows fixture focus correction. No CDP focus emulation or skip was introduced. It does not prove all desktop focus-interference schedules.
